title: Require Map Config Catalog Source Topology
forbids: map configuration catalog directories outside the closed membership, admission, and facade topology
why: A map product catalog has exactly three source owners. Closing that topology prevents support files and alternate readers from becoming parallel catalog authorities; the companion file-shape law owns their semantics.
remediate: Keep only membership.ts, admission.ts, and index.ts in a map config catalog. Membership owns ordered config ids, admission binds each id to its canonical envelope, and generators derive storage paths locally.
message: Map config catalogs must match the positive identity-membership topology.
